race.comment: CAN'T RECALL ONE (2) brings the strongest winning profile after being held up at Newcastle and still closing to within half a length in a BM72 over 1900m. He has already won around this trip, drops into BM64 grade and looks well placed to find winning form with Zac Lloyd engaged. SERPICO (4) has a good record at this course and finds an easier contest after finishing eleventh over 1800m at Randwick in BM72 class. Well drawn today and gets his chance to bounce back in the small field. DOLCE DIOR (3) has been plain at her past two in BM72 grade, yet the easier assignment, proven 2100m record and return to a more suitable set-up keep her in the place mix if she finds her earlier form. Key jockey helps. SATONO'S SHOUT (7) stretches out to this trip for the first time after struggling on the rain affected track when fifth over 2000m at Hawkesbury. Claim helps and look for a better performance.
